svg.title: Omega × ASI
svg.desc: Start with the helicopter view, all fifteen module responsibilities and function dependencies before the implementation details. M1.1 separated owner commits and proved an independent AtomStorage replacement. M1.2 now connects a pinned real Hive runtime through its native Programs action route, with real DeTTa and a fixture counterparty. The cognitive modules remain specifications. These are engineering contracts, not a final community AtomSpace or numerical model. Suggested delivery: 30–35 minutes through slide 26; seven appendices support discussion. Current evidence is the recorded 16 October 2026 M1.2 run, implementation bb22ef5, evidence snapshot 4ee5cbe.
svg.text: From independent module contracts to a real Hive caller that recovers
Architecture review • 16 October 2026 • verified native integration
OMEGA × ASI / THROUGH M1.2 / M1.2 evidence snapshot 4ee5cbe
